intro: The agency's invoices to its clients. Each action needs its own permission and is recorded.
loadFailed: Billing could not be loaded. Please try again.

premium.title: Professional billing
premium.body: Create invoices from approved hours, issue them with your own numbering and download them as PDFs with your agency's details.
premium.how: It is an add-on module. Ask ETNARA to turn it on for your agency.

readOnly.title: View only
readOnly.body: Billing is turned off for the agency. The history is kept and can be viewed; invoices cannot be created, issued or voided.

noPermission: You do not have billing permissions yet. Ask the person who manages permissions at your agency.
noManager: Your agency has several administrators. ETNARA will designate the person who manages billing permissions.
nextStage: Invoices, their PDFs and the billing details are below.

capsDetail.view: See drafts, issued invoices and their history.
capsDetail.issue: Issue invoices: assigns the number and they can no longer be edited.
capsDetail.void: Void issued invoices, always with a reason.
capsDetail.manage: Grant and revoke these permissions to other administrators.

permissions.title: Billing permissions
permissions.body: Only agency administrators can hold permissions. They are never deleted: they are revoked with a reason.
permissions.lastManagerHint: At least one person must always manage permissions.

errors.LAST_PERMISSION_MANAGER: You cannot revoke the last person who manages permissions. First grant “Manage permissions” to another administrator.
errors.BILLING_PERMISSION_EXISTS: That person already has that permission.
errors.BILLING_PERMISSION_ADMIN_ONLY: Only agency administrators can hold billing permissions.
errors.FEATURE_NOT_ENABLED: Billing is not turned on for the agency.
errors.BILLING_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.BILLING_CONCURRENT_CHANGE: Someone else changed permissions at the same time. Please try again.
errors.generic: Could not save. Please try again.
errors.DRAFT_CHANGED: Someone else changed the draft. The latest version was reloaded.
errors.SHIFT_ALREADY_RESERVED: That shift is already in another draft.
errors.SHIFT_NOT_BILLABLE: That shift cannot be billed yet.
errors.SHIFT_OTHER_CLIENT: That shift belongs to another client.
errors.SHIFT_OUTSIDE_PERIOD: That shift is outside the period.
errors.MANUAL_LINE_DUPLICATES_SHIFT: That service is already billed with a shift that day. Use the shift line.
errors.RECIPIENT_NOT_OF_CLIENT: That resident does not belong to this client.
errors.INVOICE_NOT_EDITABLE: This draft can no longer be edited.
errors.DRAFT_NOT_INACTIVE: The draft is not inactive yet.
errors.LINES_OUTSIDE_PERIOD: Some shifts fall outside the new period. Remove them first.
errors.TAX_TREATMENT_DATE_EXISTS: A version with that date already exists.
errors.RECIPIENT_REQUIRED_WITH_SERVICE: If you choose a service, choose the resident too.
errors.ISSUE_BLOCKED: It can't be issued yet. Check the “Before issuing” list.
errors.INVOICE_NOT_ISSUED: Only an issued invoice can be voided.
errors.NUMBER_CONFLICT: Another invoice took that number at the same time. Try again.
errors.INVOICE_IMMUTABLE: An issued invoice can't be changed.
errors.CLAIM_INVOICED: That shift is already on an issued invoice.
errors.PREFIX_LOCKED: The prefix can't change after the first invoice.
errors.HOLIDAY_INVOICED: That holiday was already used on an issued invoice.
errors.BILLING_STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED: The private invoice archive is not available yet.
errors.BILLING_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: The invoice archive is not responding. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.BILLING_DOCUMENT_INTEGRITY: The stored PDF doesn't match its fingerprint. It wasn't downloaded; contact support.
errors.LOGO_TOO_LARGE: The logo is larger than 300 KB.
errors.LOGO_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: The logo must be PNG or JPEG.
errors.LOGO_UNREADABLE: The logo image couldn't be read.

central.title: Billing permissions manager
central.body: ETNARA designates who grants billing permissions at the agency. ETNARA does not see invoices, rates or amounts.
central.offHint: Turn Billing on to designate the manager.
central.noAdmins: The agency has no active administrators.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.emptyHint: Create one from shifts with approved hours.
invoices.inactiveHelp: No changes in {{days}} days. Its shifts stay reserved until someone with permission releases them.
invoices.emptyIssued: No invoices in this list yet.

wizard.title: New invoice
wizard.noClients: There are no active clients. Create them in Finanzas → Clients.
wizard.periodHint: Shifts that start within the period are included (Puerto Rico time).
wizard.noShifts: This client has no shifts in the period.

draft.title: Draft
draft.discardBody: Its shifts become free for another invoice. The draft is kept as discarded.
draft.recoverTitle: Release reservations of an inactive draft
draft.recoverBody: The draft has had no changes for {{days}} days. It is discarded and its shifts become free. This is recorded.
draft.rateChanged: The rate changed since this line was added.
draft.rateChangedAll: Some rates changed. Review them and tap “Recalculate” to update the amounts.
draft.issueLater: Issuing invoices will be available in the next stage.
draft.changed: Someone else changed the draft. The latest version was reloaded.

manual.title: Manual line
manual.serviceNeedsResident: If you choose a service, choose the resident too.

tax.title: IVU treatment
tax.body: ETNARA has no preloaded rates or exemptions. Until you configure a service it counts as “pending” and cannot be issued.
tax.cpa: Confirm this treatment with your certified public accountant.
tax.onlyManager: Only the permissions manager can change it.

exceptions.TIMESHEETS_OVERLAP: Overlapping timesheets: bill it with a justified manual line
exceptions.APPROVED_EXCEEDS_RECORDED: More time approved than recorded: bill it with a justified manual line
exceptions.REAL_TIMES_MISSING: The actual check-in or check-out is missing

warnings.DAY_ALMOST_COMPLETE: {{minutes}} min short of a full day: review
warnings.UNAPPROVED_SHIFT_SAME_DAY: That day has a shift with hours not approved

blockers.ISSUING_NOT_AVAILABLE: Issuing arrives in the next stage
blockers.NEGATIVE_AMOUNT: The total or an IVU group is negative
blockers.SETTINGS_INCOMPLETE: Fill in the agency's legal name in “Billing details”
blockers.TAX_CONFIG_NOT_VALIDATED: The agency has not validated its sales tax (IVU) setup yet
blockers.STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED: The private invoice archive is not available yet

issue.blockedHint: It can be issued once the “Before issuing” list is empty.
issue.confirmBody: The agency's next consecutive number will be assigned and the PDF saved in the private archive.
issue.confirmImmutable: An issued invoice can't be edited or deleted. If something is wrong, void it with a reason and issue another.
issue.immutable: It can't be edited or deleted.
issue.voidBody: The invoice and its number are kept, marked VOIDED. Its shifts become free to bill again. This is recorded.

settings.title: Billing details
settings.body: What the PDF shows about the agency, the numbering prefix and the sales tax (IVU) setup validation.
settings.taxBody: ETNARA brings no rates or exemptions. Before issuing, the agency confirms with its accountant (CPA) how each service is treated.
settings.taxValidateBody: Confirm you reviewed each service's IVU treatment with your accountant (CPA). It is recorded with your name.
settings.taxValidateCheck: I reviewed the agency's IVU setup with our accountant.
settings.taxWithdrawBody: Issuing is blocked again until someone validates it. Issued invoices don't change.
settings.prefixLocked: Fixed since the first issued invoice.
settings.showCaregiver: Show the caregiver's name on the invoice
settings.showCaregiverHint: Off by default. Diagnoses, notes and locations are never shown.
settings.logoHint: PNG or JPEG, up to 300 KB.
